description: Get the image of a Daystruct card (Source, Data or Memory) to show the user beside your text when you introduce, use, update or report on that card. Pass the card's ID (cap_…) or exact reference, never a guessed name. Returns PNG image content plus the card's name, type and page link; if your client cannot display images, show the name and link instead and do not say an image was shown. Public cards need no key; private cards need a key on the owning account. Show a card once per response, not on every repeated step. Never required to use a capability and never charged.
name: get_daystruct_card_image
